title: Network Ops – Torrens Gulf Water
description: For Torrens Gulf Water field technicians and operations staff. Ask which DMAs are leaking and since when, which high-risk mains keep breaking, where chlorine fell below target, which incidents still need a report, and how pumping, plants and storages ran. Synthetic demo data, 1 Jan 2025 to 12 Nov 2026; built on the gold layer and the Incident Desk views.

question: Which high-risk mains have broken in the last 90 days?
Which DMAs are leaking right now, and since when?
Which DMAs fell below the chlorine target most often last summer?
Which major breaks are still missing an incident report?
What did River Murray pumping cost per ML each month this year?

description: Incident Desk register, one row per major event (173): major main breaks, storm sewer overflows, low-chlorine cases and leak alert episodes, with impact, reports on file and the suggested status. Owns events, report coverage and suggested status.

Incident Desk, one row per low-chlorine case (76): a DMA and summer with 4 or more weekly samples in a row below 0.5 mg/L, its closure test and its water quality notice. Owns the case and closure rules.

Gold, one row per DMA per day (1 Jan 2025 to 12 Nov 2026): inflow, billed volume, non-revenue water (NRW), minimum night flow against the DMA's own baseline and against all 240 DMAs, the leak alert, main breaks and weather. Owns the leak alert rule.

THE leak alert. True when a full 14-day window shows mnf_vs_peer_ratio_14d >= 1.06 AND nrw_excess_vs_peer_pp_14d >= 0.75: night flow per 1,000 connections at least 6 percent above the peer median and NRW at least 0.75 points above it, both averaged over 14 days. Use it for every question about whether, where or since when a DMA is leaking.

A noisier single-day check, not the leak alert: mnf_per_1000_conn >= 1.25 x the peer median AND nrw_pct >= 1.25 x the peer median on the day. It is often false inside a leak alert, so never use it to say whether a DMA is leaking.
Water main breaks recorded in the DMA on the day.
Major main breaks (300 or more customers affected) in the DMA on the day.
The DMA's own baseline: average min_night_flow_kl_per_hour over the 28 days before this day, kL per hour.
Minimum night flow per 1,000 connections, kL per hour. Use it, not raw night flow, to compare DMAs of different size.

min_night_flow_kl_per_hour divided by mnf_baseline_28d. Above 1 means night flow is up on the DMA's own recent baseline. A slow leak lifts the baseline too, so this only shows onset; it is not the leak alert.
mnf_per_1000_conn divided by peer_median_mnf_per_1000_conn, on the day.
Average of mnf_vs_peer_ratio over the 14 days up to and including this day. One of the two leak_alert tests.
nrw_pct minus peer_median_nrw_pct on the day, in percentage points.
Average of nrw_excess_vs_peer_pp over the 14 days up to and including this day. One of the two leak_alert tests.
Non-revenue water on the day in megalitres: inflow_ml minus billed_ml.
Average nrw_pct over the 28 days up to and including this day (fewer days before 28 Jan 2025).
Median mnf_per_1000_conn across all 240 DMAs on the same day.
Median nrw_pct across all 240 DMAs on the same day, about 7 percent.
Gold, one row per water main segment (40,000): material, era, soil, break history from 1 Jan 2025 to 12 Nov 2026, its cohort's break rate, and the break risk score and tier. Owns pipe risk.
Breaks on this main that happened on a hot, dry day.
Breaks on this main from 1 Jan 2025 to 12 Nov 2026.
The cohort's break rate, breaks per 100 km of main per year.
Mains in this main's cohort: the same material, install era and soil.
Customers affected, summed over this main's breaks.
Breaks per year expected for this main from its cohort rate and length.
Date of this main's latest break; null if it has not broken.
Major breaks on this main (300 or more customers affected).
This main's own breaks per km per year.
This main's own breaks per year (breaks_total / years_observed).
Repair cost in AUD, summed over this main's breaks.
Repair hours, summed over this main's breaks.
Percent rank of risk_score, DESCENDING: 0 is the riskiest main and 1 the least risky.

Expected breaks per km per year: this main's own record blended with its cohort's rate, so short or break-free mains lean on the cohort. Higher is riskier. Likelihood only: it ignores how many customers the main serves.
High = top 5 percent of mains by risk_score (risk_pct_rank <= 0.05, 2,000 mains), Medium = the next 15 percent (<= 0.20), Low = the rest. Likelihood only.
Length of the break record in years, about 1.86, the same for every main.

Gold, one row per day for the whole network (1 Jan 2025 to 12 Nov 2026): reservoir and bulk storage levels, River Murray pumping volume, energy and cost, plant production and energy, daily water quality counts and weather.
Average free chlorine across the day's samples, mg/L.
Average rainfall across the six service regions, mm.
Level of the bulk storage the utility holds an entitlement in, percent.
Chlorine dosed at the plants, kg.
Water produced by the seawater desalination plant, ML.
Highest maximum temperature across the regions, degrees C.
River Murray water pumped by all pump stations, ML.
Energy used by all treatment plants, MWh.
River Murray pump stations that pumped any water on the day (of 8).
Pumping energy cost per ML pumped on the day, AUD. For a period, use SUM(pumping_energy_cost_aud) / SUM(murray_ml_pumped); never average the daily values.
Energy cost of River Murray pumping, AUD.
Energy used by River Murray pumping, MWh.
Pumping energy per ML pumped on the day, kWh. For a period, use SUM(pumping_energy_mwh) * 1000 / SUM(murray_ml_pumped).
Recycled water supplied by the wastewater plants, ML.
Evaporation from all storages, ML.
Inflow to all storages, ML.
Releases from all storages, ML.
Total capacity of the urban reservoirs, ML.
Urban reservoir volume as a percent of capacity.
Water held in the urban reservoirs, ML.
Sewage flowing into the wastewater treatment plants, ML.
Water produced by the water treatment plants, ML.
Samples on the day below the 0.5 mg/L free chlorine target.
Samples on the day with E. coli detected.
Water quality samples taken on the day.
Silver, one row per district metered area (240): name, suburb, LGA, region, pressure zone, connections, dominant soil, supplying treatment plant and distance from it.
Silver, one row per water main break and its work order (17,268, 1 Jan 2025 to 12 Nov 2026), with the failed main's attributes, repair time and repair cost.
Install era band of the failed main: pre-1960, 1960-1979, 1980-1999 or 2000+.
Age of the pipe when it failed, in years.
Silver, one row per weekly water quality sample per DMA (23,351, 1 Jan 2025 to 12 Nov 2026): free chlorine against the 0.5 mg/L target, E. coli, turbidity, THMs and pH.
True when e_coli_cfu_100ml is above 0.

content:
## PURPOSE
- Network Ops agent for Torrens Gulf Water field technicians and operations staff: leaks and NRW by DMA, pipe risk and breaks, water quality, incidents and reports due, pumping, plants and storage.
- Synthetic demo utility with South Australian place names; data runs 1 Jan 2025 to 12 Nov 2026.

## DISAMBIGUATION
- "Now", "today", "currently", "this week" and "last 90 days" are relative to the last day of data (12 Nov 2026), never current_date().
- "Leaking" or "leak alert" means gold_dma_nrw_daily.leak_alert. leak_alert_daily is a noisier daily check: never use it to say whether a DMA is leaking.
- "Major" break means is_major: 300 or more customers affected.
- Pipe "risk" means gold_main_break_risk.risk_tier and risk_score: likelihood of a break, not consequence.
- "Incidents", "events" and "reports due" mean incident_events.
- A summer runs 1 Dec to 31 Mar; "last summer" is summer 2025-26.

## DATA QUALITY NOTES
- incident_events statuses are suggestions derived from the data; statuses people save in the Incident Desk app are not visible here.

## CONSTRAINTS
- Never invent thresholds, watch-lists or scores. The leak, risk and chlorine rules are defined in the data; quote them from the column descriptions.

## Instructions you must follow when providing summaries
- State the dates used.
- Show dma_name and region_name next to dma_id; volumes in ML, money in AUD.
- Round volumes and percentages to 1 decimal place, scores and ratios to 2.

question: Which major breaks still have no incident report on file?
sql:
SELECT e.event_id AS break_id, e.event_date AS failed_on, e.title, e.region_name, e.dma_name,
  CAST(e.impact_value AS INT) AS customers_affected, e.asset_risk_tier, e.suggested_status, e.suggested_reason
FROM adllabs_096.default.incident_events e
WHERE e.event_type = 'major_break' AND NOT e.report_on_file
ORDER BY e.event_date DESC

question: Show the weekly NRW and night flow trend for Unley DMA 7 against the network median
sql:
SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', n.obs_date) AS DATE) AS week,
  ROUND(AVG(n.nrw_pct), 2) AS nrw_pct, ROUND(AVG(n.peer_median_nrw_pct), 2) AS network_median_nrw_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(n.mnf_per_1000_conn), 2) AS night_flow_per_1000_conn, ROUND(AVG(n.peer_median_mnf_per_1000_conn), 2) AS network_median_night_flow,
  COUNT_IF(n.leak_alert) AS leak_alert_days
FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily n
WHERE n.dma_name = 'Unley DMA 7'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: What did River Murray pumping cost per ML each month?
sql:
SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', o.obs_date) AS DATE) AS month, ROUND(SUM(o.murray_ml_pumped), 0) AS ml_pumped,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pumping_energy_cost_aud), 0) AS energy_cost_aud,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pumping_energy_cost_aud) / NULLIF(SUM(o.murray_ml_pumped), 0), 2) AS cost_aud_per_ml,
  ROUND(AVG(o.urban_storage_level_pct), 1) AS avg_urban_storage_pct
FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_operations_daily o
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
usage_guidance: Recompute cost per ML from the sums; never average the daily ratio.

question: When did each leak alert start, and how much water has it lost?
sql:
SELECT e.dma_id, e.dma_name, e.region_name, e.event_date AS alert_started, e.suggested_status AS status,
  CASE WHEN e.suggested_status = 'Open' THEN DATEDIFF((SELECT MAX(obs_date) FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily), e.event_date) + 1 END AS days_open,
  ROUND(e.impact_value, 1) AS ml_lost_above_peer_estimate
FROM adllabs_096.default.incident_events e
WHERE e.event_type = 'leak_alert'
ORDER BY e.event_date
usage_guidance: Leak episodes come from incident_events, which groups consecutive leak_alert days.

question: Which DMAs are leaking right now?
sql:
SELECT n.dma_id, n.dma_name, n.region_name, n.obs_date AS as_of,
  ROUND(n.nrw_pct, 1) AS nrw_pct, ROUND(n.peer_median_nrw_pct, 1) AS peer_median_nrw_pct,
  ROUND(n.mnf_vs_peer_ratio_14d, 2) AS night_flow_vs_peer_14d, ROUND(n.nrw_excess_vs_peer_pp_14d, 2) AS nrw_points_above_peer_14d
FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily n
WHERE n.obs_date = (SELECT MAX(obs_date) FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily) AND n.leak_alert
ORDER BY n.nrw_excess_vs_peer_pp_14d DESC
usage_guidance: Leaking now = leak_alert on the last day of data.

question: What is the break rate per 100 km per year by pipe material and soil?
sql:
SELECT r.material, r.soil_type, COUNT(*) AS mains, ROUND(SUM(r.length_m) / 1000, 1) AS km, SUM(r.breaks_total) AS breaks,
  ROUND(SUM(r.breaks_total) * 100.0 / (SUM(r.length_m) / 1000.0 * MAX(r.years_observed)), 1) AS breaks_per_100km_yr
FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_main_break_risk r
GROUP BY r.material, r.soil_type
ORDER BY breaks_per_100km_yr DESC

question: Which DMAs fell below the chlorine target most often last summer?
sql:
SELECT q.dma_id, d.dma_name, d.region_name, d.treatment_plant_name, ROUND(d.distance_from_plant_km, 1) AS km_from_plant,
  COUNT(*) AS samples, COUNT_IF(q.below_chlorine_target) AS below_target, ROUND(MIN(q.free_chlorine_mg_l), 2) AS lowest_mg_l
FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.silver_water_quality q
JOIN adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.silver_dim_dma d ON q.dma_id = d.dma_id
WHERE q.sampled_on BETWEEN DATE'2025-12-01' AND DATE'2026-03-31'
GROUP BY q.dma_id, d.dma_name, d.region_name, d.treatment_plant_name, d.distance_from_plant_km
HAVING COUNT_IF(q.below_chlorine_target) > 0
ORDER BY below_target DESC, lowest_mg_l
LIMIT 20
usage_guidance: A summer runs 1 Dec to 31 Mar; as of 12 Nov 2026, last summer is 2025-26.

question: Which high-risk mains have broken in the last 90 days?
sql:
SELECT b.main_id, r.dma_name, r.region_name, r.material, r.install_year, r.soil_type, r.risk_tier,
  ROUND(r.risk_score, 3) AS risk_score, COUNT(*) AS breaks_last_90_days, MAX(b.failed_on) AS last_break,
  SUM(b.customers_affected) AS customers_affected
FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.silver_main_breaks b
JOIN adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_main_break_risk r ON b.main_id = r.main_id
WHERE r.risk_tier = 'High'
  AND b.failed_on > (SELECT MAX(x.failed_on) FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.silver_main_breaks x) - INTERVAL 90 DAYS
GROUP BY b.main_id, r.dma_name, r.region_name, r.material, r.install_year, r.soil_type, r.risk_tier, r.risk_score
ORDER BY breaks_last_90_days DESC, last_break DESC
LIMIT 50
usage_guidance: Anchor the window to the latest failed_on, not today. One row per main keeps the list short.

question: What is the mean time to repair by failure type and probable cause?
sql:
SELECT b.failure_type, b.probable_cause, COUNT(*) AS breaks, ROUND(AVG(b.repair_hours), 1) AS mean_repair_hours,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE(b.repair_hours, 0.9), 1) AS p90_repair_hours, ROUND(AVG(b.repair_cost_aud), 0) AS mean_repair_cost_aud
FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.silver_main_breaks b
GROUP BY b.failure_type, b.probable_cause
ORDER BY breaks DESC

measures.display_name: Water lost above peer level (ML, estimate)
Pumping energy cost per ML over a period

question: What rule triggers a leak alert?
evaluation_note: Must say the alert uses 14-day averages over a full 14 days: night flow per 1,000 connections at least 1.06 times the peer median and NRW at least 0.75 percentage points above the peer median. Reject an answer that gives the 1.25 times daily thresholds as the alert rule (that is leak_alert_daily).

question: How many low-chlorine cases are open?

content: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_cases FROM adllabs_096.default.incident_events e WHERE e.event_type = 'low_chlorine' AND e.suggested_status = 'Open'

question: When did the Unley DMA 7 leak alert start, and how many days has it been running?

content: SELECT MIN(n.obs_date) AS alert_started, COUNT(*) AS alert_days FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily n WHERE n.dma_id = 'DMA-ADS-007' AND n.leak_alert

question: List the High risk mains inside DMAs that are on leak alert today

content: SELECT r.main_id, r.dma_name, r.material, r.install_year, r.soil_type FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_main_break_risk r WHERE r.risk_tier = 'High' AND r.dma_id IN (SELECT n.dma_id FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily n WHERE n.obs_date = (SELECT MAX(obs_date) FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily) AND n.leak_alert)

question: How much water has Unley DMA 7 lost above the peer level during its leak alert?

content: SELECT ROUND(SUM(n.inflow_ml * GREATEST(n.nrw_excess_vs_peer_pp, 0) / 100), 1) AS ml_lost FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily n WHERE n.dma_id = 'DMA-ADS-007' AND n.leak_alert

question: How many mains are in the High risk tier?

content: SELECT COUNT(*) AS mains FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_main_break_risk r WHERE r.risk_tier = 'High'

question: Which pipe material breaks most often per kilometre?

content: SELECT r.material, ROUND(SUM(r.breaks_total) * 100.0 / (SUM(r.length_m) / 1000.0 * MAX(r.years_observed)), 1) AS breaks_per_100km_yr FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_main_break_risk r GROUP BY r.material ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: How many major main breaks have there been since the start of 2025?

content: SELECT COUNT(*) AS major_breaks FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.silver_main_breaks b WHERE b.is_major

question: What was the average River Murray pumping cost per ML in 2026?

content: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.pumping_energy_cost_aud) / SUM(o.murray_ml_pumped), 2) AS aud_per_ml FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_operations_daily o WHERE YEAR(o.obs_date) = 2026

question: How many days was Unley DMA 7 on leak alert in 2025?

content: SELECT COUNT_IF(n.leak_alert) AS alert_days FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily n WHERE n.dma_id = 'DMA-ADS-007' AND YEAR(n.obs_date) = 2025

question: How many major breaks are still waiting for an incident report?

content: SELECT COUNT(*) AS breaks FROM adllabs_096.default.incident_events e WHERE e.event_type = 'major_break' AND NOT e.report_on_file

question: Is any DMA on leak alert at the moment?

content: SELECT n.dma_id, n.dma_name FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily n WHERE n.obs_date = (SELECT MAX(obs_date) FROM adllabs_096.water_utilities_medallion.gold_dma_nrw_daily) AND n.leak_alert
